question: If a 12 V power supply supplies a power of 24 W to a bulb, then the power supplied would be when connected to a 6 V supply:
solution:
The correct answer is __**6W**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We** know Power (P) = V²/R**,

 
 
• where **V is voltage and R is resistance.**
 
• When **V = 12V and P = 24W, **
 
• we can find** R: 24 = 12²/R**
 
 
• 24 = 144/R
 
• R = 144/24
 
• R = 6 ohms
 
 
 
 
 
• **Calculate the power at 6V:**
 
 
• Now, we use the same formula with V = 6V
 
 
• and the resistance we just calculated:
 
• P = 6²/6
 
• P = 36/6
 
• P = 6W
 
 
 
 
 
• **Therefore, the correct answer is 3) 6W.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
